scope: Market-aware generated-site retailer link policy and market price unit verification
securityCases: EN Japan reference may use ordinary Japanese official URL
JA international reference may use ordinary English official URL
Approved English affiliate is accepted only on the English page
English approved affiliate and disguised tracking URL are rejected on Japanese pages
Unknown catalog IDs, wrong market labels and alternate product destinations are rejected
limitations: A policy unit run and generated-site static verification do not replace browser or hosted deployment verification.
Catalog checks validate the recorded merchant destination, not current inventory, physical shelf prices or checkout totals.
